name: Sanan
info1: I build full-stack web applications with PHP/Laravel and React. I strive to enhance my skills every day. I hope you will enjoy my work from my portfolio.
about2: I got interested in IT fields and after some research, I decided to dive into Front-end development around November 2022. Over time that curiosity grew into the backend as well, and today, with 2+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer, I build features end-to-end — pairing Laravel/CodeIgniter backends with React frontends. I write RESTful APIs, implement authentication and structured error handling, and optimize MySQL queries through indexing. I also own deployment myself — configuring Nginx/Apache and SSL on Ubuntu servers, managing cron jobs, and monitoring logs and performance over SSH. Improving user experiences and creating simple, reliable interfaces are my primary goals. Continuous learning is a lifelong journey for me — adapting to evolving technologies is a natural requirement in this field. I actively participate in code reviews, exchanging feedback with teammates to uphold clean-code standards.
